name: Somatic Reset
instructions: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Name 3 things you see; light bilateral taps for 60–90s..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
